title: Czochralski silicon crystal puller
author: zintaen
prompt: Build an interactive 3D and WebGL Czochralski single-crystal silicon puller with an RF-heated quartz crucible, a live WebGL thermal-convection melt pool and glowing solidification meniscus, a cantilevered seed pullhead lifting a monocrystalline silicon boule, and a coupled pull-rate control dial.
